limitations: Fresh assistant-authored synthetic assertions, registered before any model call on these cases. Not human labels, organizer ground truth, independent accuracy evidence, or a model ranking. The author did not read raw FBroker/control conversations or actual control predictions. Scope is only clearly determined discovery and dialogue decisions.

items.scenario: General conditional procedure without a private account status lookup

expected_results.rationale: The request is for a general conditional route, not the actual status of a private profile. The supplied help text and requested action suffice.
The conditional branches are explicit and connected to the question; no hold or confusion is present.

items.scenario: Essential document variant clarified before a tailored answer

expected_results.rationale: The model determines which of two instructions is applicable and was initially missing. The operator obtains it before selecting a document.
The relevant clarification and subsequent answer form a clear sequence.

items.scenario: Essential document variant guessed without clarification

expected_results.rationale: The pump model is indispensable to selecting the matching manual. Neither the client nor any other source supplies it, and the operator selects one without asking.
The answer is linguistically clear and easy to follow. Its unsupported selection is a discovery/consultation issue, with no separate dialogue-flow failure.

items.scenario: Explicit operator handling hold with no advance operator warning

expected_results.rationale: The client supplies both visible options and the desired format, so no clarification is required.
A SYSTEM event explicitly starts and ends waiting during assigned operator handling. The operator never warns beforehand. This is one flow failure; the final instruction remains clear.

items.scenario: Bot-announced queue before the first operator joins

expected_results.rationale: The visible link and desired public document are already known before the operator joins.
The waiting belongs entirely to the pre-operator queue and the bot warned about it. The first operator reply is clear; no operator hold or flow failure occurs.

items.scenario: Operator announces a handling hold before the system starts it

expected_results.rationale: The requested format and matching visible option are explicit from the start.
The operator gives an explicit advance warning before the SYSTEM-confirmed handling hold and returns with a clear answer.

items.scenario: Client explicitly denies waiting; no hold event

expected_results.rationale: The desired evening programme is specified, and both link labels are given.
The reference to waiting is explicitly negated. There is no actual hold or warning obligation established by the transcript.

items.scenario: Missing delivery format clarified before selecting an option

expected_results.rationale: The desired delivery format was genuinely missing and determines which option to select. The operator asks and uses the answer before advising.
The clarification precedes a concise instruction that uses the supplied preference.

items.scenario: Timestamps alone without evidence of an operator hold

expected_results.rationale: The desired public document and visible link are already specified; no private state is relevant.
Only a timestamp gap precedes the first reply. There is no explicit operator handling hold, and the checklist excludes a first-response threshold.

items.scenario: A completed check immediately includes the answer

expected_results.rationale: The client names both options and the intended format, leaving no required detail missing.
The operator reports a completed check and gives the answer in the same turn. This does not establish a waiting period needing an advance warning.

items.scenario: Essential revision omitted and one revision selected without asking

expected_results.rationale: The scanner revision is essential to matching its guide. No source supplies it, and the operator chooses revision Y without clarification.
The instruction is clear as wording and sequence. The missing prerequisite concerns discovery and correctness, not a separate communication-flow defect.

items.scenario: System-confirmed waiting during operator handling without notice

expected_results.rationale: The requested content and exact visible link are known from the first message.
The SYSTEM events explicitly establish a hold during the assigned operator handling. No operator warning precedes it. The otherwise clear answer leaves exactly one visible flow failure.
